body: The reminders is fantastic in enabling one to dedicate a clear and well organised “to do list” for all sorts of things in life, from scheduled work reminders to shopping. One slight change I might  suggest to the reminders app is a feature that allows you to arrange reminders due ‘today’ into morning, afternoon, evening, without setting specific times dedicated to those times of the day. The reminders app with this feature should allow for the allotting of reminders into the separate parts of the day, for example, instead of allotting a reminder in the afternoon which would automatically be set at 13:00 , rather allow for the allotting of that said reminder in a subsection called ‘Afternoon’ which does not set it at 13:00 but stays in that subcategory until the reminder is ticked or completed. It would be grateful if Apple Inc to this suggestion on board and applied it newer versions ir updates of the reminders app, as I believe that it will significantly benefit other customers use of the reminders app as a whole.

title: Transformative app particularly for hyperactive neurodiverse brains
body:
I can’t begin to explain the difference this has made to my life. I didn’t use this for so long because I didn’t understand how it differed from just adding to my calendar reminders, but it has streamlined my brain so significantly, that ultimately I have become so much more productive.  

I’m constantly adding general reminders and thoughts throughout the day, often using the mic for speed, then I spend a few minutes organising them into dates and times when they are realistically going to happen, so they pop up on my phone when I’m going to be in a certain place or with a particular person.  I also have ongoing projects or jobs that they are filed into, in order to organise my brain a little better.

Templates make it easy to have a reoccurring list, like packing or meal plans to use again and again.  Adding pictures and hashtags to focus are really useful to filter down and link back to other apps, such as Instagram for example - making quick reference super easy.  I use this particularly for products I like or recipes - which you can quickly just save back to your reminders to a meal planner.

If you have a neurodiverse brain and your thought process is like a broadband cable firing thoughts and ideas at you 24/7, then this app will help you organise those thoughts into an achievable lists of tasks and ideas.  It’s actually freed up some of the hard drive on my brain making my actual memory work better and it has certainly helped with my sense of overwhelm.  Love it.

However, since a recent release (with changed UI) an annoying characteristic had crept in - when I click on a completed daily repeating reminder, the reminder does not immediately disappear as it should, so I press again and find I have marked tomorrow’s reminder as completed (and sometimes the day after that).
There is no way that tomorrow’s reminder should appear in today’s list for this to be allowed to happen.
So I have to be alert to this and undo the future reminders. Otherwise I have no reminder set for the next day and may miss a needed action.
I would be very pleased if the development team check this out and correct it.

body: I am an incredibly heavy user of the Reminders app. It is an essential part of my daily life and I don’t know what I would do without it! Its highlighting feature for me is its amazing design. title: This feels like a downgrade
body:
I have been in the habit of using Reminders on a daily basis. In recent years, I'm not sure going how far back, it has been possible to click on "Manage" against the notification for a reminder, then mark it complete without exiting the lockscreen. In this way, a series of reminders could quickly and easily be completed from the lockscreen. Since iOS15, this functionality has disappeared in favour of incessantly prompting to turn off time-sensitive  reminders - all of them (why? Who would need to do that.) or disable other classes of reminder, similarly far-fetched use cases. This "improvement" affects notifications from other apps like Fantastical also, so maybe it's the notifications system that's gone awry. 
In any case, can we please have this back?
The current work flow if you have say three notifications, say two from reminders and one from Calendar, you are forced to click through to open the Reminders app, where ok you can complete however many are up within that app; but then you have ro close the phone, open the lockscreen, slide up to view remaining notifications and go through the same DUMB process again.
